title: The Pudding Cup
description: The best visual and data-driven stories of 2026

prelude.value: We’re back with The Pudding Cup, the ninth-annual celebration of the best non-commercial* visual and data-driven projects of the year. Our goal is to give these projects the attention they deserve but might not receive. Judges’ favorites will get a cash prize for their hard work. Here’s what you need to know:

preludeTenth.value: To be completely honest: we almost didn’t do it this year.
Over the last year, we’ve felt the same AI fatigue a lot of you probably have. Our inboxes and feeds have been flooded.
The Pudding has always been about more than just a shiny end result. It’s about what it took to get there: the ambition, the struggle, the triumph, and the hope of sharing a discovery.
We’re not here to police how you create a visual data-driven story, but if your project doesn’t have a heartbeat, it’s not getting the Cup!

So, the submissions are open… for now. But if we find ourselves drowning in slop, we’ll close the form, and figure out how to reinvent the Cup into something entirely different that maintains our values. We really hope we don't have to.
Here’s what you need to know:

details.value: Entries are free, just give us a URL! (One per person, please)
Must have been published / put on the internet in 2026
Highly encouraged to share your process and raw materials
Up to three winners will each receive $1,500.
Winners Announced - The week of December 07, 2026
More info in the form, but hit us up at sup@pudding.cool with questions!

commercial: Non-commercial projects = things created without compensation. It was made for learning, fun, school, a contest, etc. Not for work or hire.

wrap.value: We’re excited to announce the winners of our ninth-annual Pudding Cup! Our judges selected these three projects from close to 100 entries. Each will receive $1,500 for their hard work.
